narration.text: [whispers] Her hair was short. Once. [long pause] [softly] Hokkaido, Japan. Nineteen thirty-eight. A family moving away left a doll at a temple. They called her Okiku. [long pause] The story is that she belonged to a little girl who died young. [long pause] Then the priests noticed her hair. It was growing. [long pause] The temple says it has grown about twenty-five centimetres. When it is trimmed, it grows back. [long pause] Some say it is a child's hair. That has never been shown. [long pause] Skeptics say old hair can relax and stretch. Or that someone is doing it. [long pause] Eighty-eight years. Look where she was facing, at the start. [long pause] [whispers] Look where she's facing now.
